definitions.gloss: years; months and years; time; passage of time
definitions.explanation: A period of time, typically a long one spanning years. Often used to emphasize the duration or passage of time.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}い{年月|ねんげつ}をかけて{完成|かんせい}させた。
examples.english: It was completed over many years.

examples.japanese: {年月|ねんげつ}が{経|た}つのは{早|はや}いものだ。
examples.notes: [Note: 年月が経つ is a common expression for the passage of time]

examples.japanese: あれから{随分|ずいぶん}{年月|ねんげつ}が{流|なが}れた。
examples.english: A lot of time has passed since then.
examples.notes: [Note: 年月が流れる also means 'time passes']

notes:
READING: Also read as としつき, which is a native Japanese reading with the same meaning. ねんげつ is the more common reading in formal contexts.

PATTERNS:
・{年月|ねんげつ}をかける (to spend years on)
・{年月|ねんげつ}が{経|た}つ/{過|す}ぎる (time passes)
・{年月|ねんげつ}が{流|なが}れる (time flows/passes)
・{長|なが}い{年月|ねんげつ} (many years)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{歳月|さいげつ} (years, time - more literary)
・{時間|じかん} (time - general)
・{月日|つきひ} (days and months, time)
